notes: RNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling study (libraries as McGlincy and Ingolia 2017), so assay_class other per settled rule. Medium not named ('medium'); A600 ~0.4 lies in both the complex and minimal ranges, so mid_exponential inferred. Apidaecin (translation-termination inhibiting peptide) put under abx_translation.
